Curated Consults
Expert guidance for one specific piece of the puzzle.​

Product Consultation

Helpful for any stage of parenthood! Are you feeling overwhelmed by a few important decisions? If you are trying to choose a car seat, preparing a grandparent’s home, purchasing travel gear, or upgrading for another child, I can help!

Registry Consultation

If your registry is complete or partially complete, but you would like a professional to review and provide tailored Nesting Notes to ensure your priorities, needs, and wishes are met, this one is for you.

Nursery Consultation

Work with me to create a beautiful and functional nursery, bringing your vision to life with an experienced eye for design.

Preparation Consultation

Could you use help with logistics before baby arrives? Pediatrician meet-and-greets, birthing classes, hospital tour, doulas, PT etc.? Allow me to help you coordinate all necessary appointments.
